summary: Establish the Gradle 8.14.3 multi-module build foundation (module layout, dependency declarations, TinyHttpd composite build, JUnit/Kotlin smoke tests, API 21 and kotlin-stdlib build checks, docs/CLAUDE.md module names) for issue #1.
key_entities: root settings.gradle / build.gradle (single root build file, no per-module build files)
SLF4J / rotating file / Logcat Logger modules (NaruServe- prefix)
TinyHttpd includeBuild via Gradle property (default /Users/beom/work/git/TinyHttpd, commit 46b973e)
JUnit 4.13.2, Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.x, Java and Kotlin smoke tests
ambiguities: Final names of the SLF4J, rotating file and Logcat Logger modules are only said to take the NaruServe- prefix; the exact suffixes are not fixed by design items or wave decisions.
Which nullability annotation library is used (D-026 leaves it to #1; only the constraints compileOnly and Kotlin-recognised are set).
implied_requirements: Automated build check that NaruServe-api sources/classpath contain no android, servlet, Gson or TinyHttpd references (integration item I-002).
Automated build check that only Gson 2.14.0 appears on any classpath (integration item I-005).
Build check failing when a non-Kotlin module has kotlin-stdlib on runtimeClasspath (D-388).
TinyHttpd adapter declares TinyHttpd with implementation scope only, never api (wave decision W2-006).
Root project renamed NaruServe-build to avoid coordinate clash with the NaruServe bootstrap module in the composite build (W2-001).
Missing TinyHttpd directory fails at configuration time with a message naming the property and path (D-015).
docs/api/servlet.md jakarta marker is left for wave 8; rest-kotlin name replaced in CLAUDE.md and docs/api/kotlin.md (W2-003, W2-005).
Root ./gradlew build passes on JDK 17 without an Android SDK (D-025).
